title: Unearthed
description:
S08 E03 — Legend of King Midas
King Midas and his legendary golden touch is one of the most famous tales in Greek mythology; using advanced archaeological methods, experts travel deep inside mysterious ancient mounds to investigate the truth behind the myth.

title: Unearthed
description:
S08 E06 — Secrets of Seahenge
A prehistoric mega-structure emerges from the sands of an English shore that could reveal lost mysteries of the Bronze Age; using pioneering technology and 3D imaging analysis, experts uncover dark, ancient rituals once performed here.

title: Unearthed
description:
S08 E02 — Rome's Gate to Hell
According to legend, the ancient Roman city of Hierapolis hides a secret portal to the underworld beneath its streets; armed with pioneering technology, archaeologists gain rare access to investigate the deadly truth behind these hellish myths.

title: Unearthed
description:
S08 E04 — Ghosts of Venice
Venice was once a fearsome superpower home to secrets, wealth, and treachery; today, scientists use pioneering acoustic imaging technology to discover the city's ancient foundations and reveal how it's still standing.

title: Unearthed
description:
S10 E12 — Olous: Lost City of the Ancients
The lost city of Olous: A great metropolis submerged in the Mediterranean; archaeologists uncover its secrets using pioneering technology and CGI reconstruction.

The Pantheon is a 2,000-year-old temple with a secret; using cutting-edge archaeological methods and brand-new evidence, experts look beneath the streets of Rome to find out why it was built and how it survived so long.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S03 E05 — The Moon that Disappeared
Recently discovered documents show NASA's secret plan B for failure of the first moon landing; a Soyuz capsule carrying NASA astronaut Peggy Whitson back to Earth goes missing; NASA's Cassini mission unravels a three-hundred-year-old.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S03 E06 — Curse of the Red Planet
Three cosmonauts mysteriously die as they re-enter Earth's atmosphere and NASA needs to know why; a declassified document shows a CIA plan to use a space disaster as a cover to start World War 3.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S09 E08 — Secret Lives of Neutrinos
Neutrinos are the most mysterious particles in the universe, and they power some of the most explosive events in the cosmos; new discoveries reveal how these ghosts pass through objects undetected and why they could be the reason humans exist.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S09 E02 — Mission to a Comet
The Rosetta mission is a groundbreaking expedition to land on a comet for the very first time; special access reveals what this cutting-edge journey discovers and how these mysterious objects help create life on Earth.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S09 E10 — Gravitational Waves Revealed
Gravitational waves are helping scientists explore the cosmos in revolutionary, new ways, and the discoveries they make are revealing the universe's greatest mysteries.

title: Mythical Beasts
description:
S01 E02 — The Kraken Awakens
New discoveries suggest that a sea beast like the Kraken could have existed, and experts examine a strange monster that could give shocking answers into this underwater mystery.

title: Mythical Beasts
description:
S01 E04 — Revenge of the Cyclops
New discoveries reveal the terrifying evidence of the cyclops, a one-eyed cannibal that could have been more than just a story.

title: Mythical Beasts
description:
S01 E09 — Call of the Werewolf
Werewolves were once so feared, people suspected of the power were hunted and killed, but even so, many admitted that they could become these deadly creatures, and new evidence reveals why a powerful hallucinogenic drug could be to blame.

title: Mythical Beasts
description:
S01 E03 — Curse of the Vampire
Terrifying new discoveries reveal the bloody truth behind the legends of vampires, and experts investigate why people believed these monsters had a taste for human blood.

title: Mythical Beasts
description:
S01 E10 — Hunting the Loch Ness Monster
New discoveries reveal the truth behind the Loch Ness Monster, and experts investigate the world's most mysterious waters in search of evidence that a prehistoric monster could still be lurking in the deep.

title: Mythical Beasts
description:
S01 E07 — Dark Secrets of the Sphinx
New discoveries uncover the dark secrets of Egypt's strange half-man, half-lion beast, revealing why the pharaohs were so intent on transforming into this powerful and ferocious monster.

title: Mythical Beasts
description:
S01 E06 — Wrath of the Minotaur
A new excavation at the mysterious home of the Minoans leads to a startling discovery about real-life origins of the Minotaur, and experts decode artifacts that point to bloody human sacrifices for the ferocious monster.

title: Dino Hunters
description:
S01 E01 — Dinosaur Cowboys
Dinosaur fossil season has begun, and Montana rancher Clayton Phipps finds what might be an extremely rare and valuable fossil on his family's property.

title: Dino Hunters
description:
S01 E02 — Million-Dollar Dino
Clayton Phipps continues his excavation of a rare carnivorous dinosaur on his Montana ranch; Mike Harris and son Jake prepare to sell their prized Tyrannosaurus rex fossil; Aaron Bolan hunts for an Ankylosaurus.

title: Dino Hunters
description:
S01 E03 — Curse of the Carnivore
Clayton Phipps and his team prepare to flip a 20,000-pound carnivore fossil out of the earth and onto a flatbed to get it to the lab for analysis; Mike Harris hunts for a duckbill skull; Jared Hudson uncovers an ancient reptile.

title: Dino Hunters
description:
S01 E04 — Shots Fired
Clayton must haul his 20,000-pound dinosaur fossil over 200 miles to a lab where it will finally be identified; the Harris/Bolan clan chases poachers off of their land; Jared makes a last-ditch effort to bring in some money this season.

title: Dino Hunters
description:
S01 E05 — We Got Skull
Clayton returns to his ranch in Montana to hunt for quick finds at Old Faithful. In Wyoming, Mike Harris and his team continue excavating their triceratops site hoping to uncover the valuable horns.

title: Dino Hunters
description:
S01 E06 — The Verdict Is In: Nano or T-Rex
In Montana, Clayton Phipps prepares to learn if his carnivore skeleton belongs to a Tyrannosaurus rex or the controversial Nanotyrannus; in Wyoming, Mike Harris and Aaron Bolan race against the impending winter digging at a promising new site.

description:
S03 E07 — Red Storm Rising
Two astronauts trapped in the vacuum of space face a horrible death; the first close up images of Pluto show an alien landscape; residents of Houston struggle to explain videos of unidentified flying lights captured above their city at night.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S03 E08 — Attack of the Thunderballs
Astronauts evacuate when a mystery object hurtles toward the ISS; a NASA secret agent goes undercover to retrieve missing moon rocks; scientists struggle to find answers when they discover a huge void at the edge of the solar system.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S09 E06 — War of the Galaxies
Galaxies are locked in continual combat across the universe, and the Milky Way will face its biggest opponent ever, the Andromeda Galaxy, in a titanic and deadly struggle that could create a new and unrecognizable super galaxy.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S09 E09 — Birth of the Monster Black Holes
New discoveries reveal an astonishing supermassive black hole that was born during the earliest days of the cosmos, and finding out how this giant grew so large so quickly may help to explain the very formation of the universe itself.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S09 E03 — Secrets of the Sun
A brand-new NASA mission to the sun reveals cutting-edge discoveries about Earth's star; as the Parker Solar Probe dives through the sun's atmosphere, its findings challenge everything known about this strange place.

title: Strange Evidence
description:
S06 E03 — Curse of Zombie Island
A village mourner at an Indonesian funeral films a dead man's hand waving through the glass window of a coffin; experts investigate and uncover powerful local priests and the practice of black magic rituals to reanimate corpses back from the dead.

title: Strange Evidence
description:
S06 E04 — Tsunami of Fire
A security camera captures panic in Lima, Peru, as a wave of fire chases terrified citizens down a city street claiming 30 lives; experts uncover reports of a disastrous fuel tanker accident with an inadequate and fatal safety response.

title: Strange Evidence
description:
S06 E05 — Train Track Terror
Security cameras capture a baby stroller pushed by a mysterious force across a London subway platform and crash onto the tracks; experts investigate and uncover a disturbing history of paranormal incidents surrounding London's subway system.

title: Strange Evidence
description:
S06 E06 — Explosion From the Underworld
Security cameras in China capture a sudden explosion beneath a city street that buries two young girls in debris; experts investigate and uncover a black market of secondhand cooking oil that may be dangerously festering in the city's sewers.

title: Strange Evidence
description:
S06 E07 — Attack of the Raging Inferno
Cameras in Kazakhstan capture a bizarre blast as train cars on a quiet railway suddenly explode in a raging inferno.

title: Alien Encounters: Fact or Fiction
description:

After the death of his father, a farmer believes he witnessed a UFO; a geologist uncovers debris at the Roswell crash site; after seeing an orb in the sky, a mother suffers radiation-like burns on her body.

Tormented by childhood memories of abduction, a woman discovers an implant in her body; a sailor captures lights over the Pacific Ocean that he believes are alien craft, and a couple finds unusual footprints in the woods.

The USS Arizona and the HMS Hood were two of the most powerful warships in history, but their weaknesses paid a fatal price; experts investigate evidence that may reveal why the age of the battleship has come to a sudden and violent end.

description:
S01 E04 — Assassins of the Deep
The wreckages of three German U-boats are eroding at the bottom of the sea along with the stories behind their disastrous fate; now, a team of maritime archaeologists race to locate the submarines and solve the mystery behind their deadly demise.

title: Abandoned: Expedition Shipwreck
description:
S01 E02 — Danger Ahead
The enigmatic shipwrecks of El Faro and the Empress of Ireland occurred a century apart and both remain a mystery of the sea; armed with the latest technology, experts explore these doomed ships to discover what set them on the path to catastrophe.
